conditions.count_excess_vs_independent: the source is independent, the edition's status group is not verified, official_finishers is present, and n_db > (1 + tolerance) × official_finishers

conditions.independent: official_source_type, lowercased (a null as empty), matches independent_pattern and does not match not_independent_pattern
conditions.order: the first of the three that applies, in this order; every inequality is strict

edition_rules.computed_on: named per screen. n_db is every row loaded for the edition's city and year: its race_records rows of the half database, whatever record rule removes them, plus its rows in RELEASE-ROW-EXCLUSIONS.parquet (the release removes rows the earlier snapshots still held); an edition with no row in race_records has n_db 0. n_usable is the edition's record-usable rows before R7 (rows no record rule R1, R8, R2–R6 removes, R7 not applied), and the edition's median, 99th percentile, share under 1:05 and recorded-sex counts are over those rows. E3 count_excess_vs_independent, E3 rows_short_of_source_list and E6 compare n_db; E3 count_shortfall_vs_independent, E4, E5, E7 and E8 use n_usable
edition_rules.edition: city and year within the half database (source_db = half); the tier from EDITION-TIERS.csv, the registry row from edition_meta.parquet, both joined on city and year

never_stamp_from.table: the never_stamp table of half-dataset-20261030-1904 (analysis/half-policy-20261030-1904.json stamps.never_stamp)

reads.course_suspected_short: the editions whose every row of the half database carries course_shortened_suspect in the person-links file: equal to `course_suspected_short`; an edition flagged on some rows only fails (lead decision D24, item 10)
reads.gross_timing: the editions whose edition_meta.timing_basis, lowercased, starts with gross: equal to `gross_timing`, and each held (lead decision D6)
reads.never_stamp: each row of `never_stamp` (the 1904 snapshot's never_stamp table, carried verbatim with the year and label its edition id carries in this release): the edition with that id must exist with that year and must not carry a badge tier; a changed label is reported, not failed
reads.removed_and_empty: an edition whose tier is excluded, or whose registry tier is no_rows, holds no row in race_records
reads.stamped: the edition ids whose tier is stamped or stamped_weaker_source, equal to `stamped`
reads.weaker_source: the edition ids whose tier is stamped_weaker_source, equal to `weaker_source`, each with its city, year and official_source_type under the reason rule's length cut; after the edition rules each is a verified usable edition

tiers.reason_rule: the first ' | '-separated part of the corrected completeness_reason that contains 'unstamped', else the first part; runs of spaces, tabs and newlines made one space; over 160 characters, cut to the last space within the first 159 and ended with '…'
tiers.rule: verified = tier stamped or stamped_weaker_source in the release's EDITION-TIERS.csv, equal to the policy's reviewed list, never an edition of the frozen never-stamp list
tiers.source: EDITION-TIERS.csv (verification_tier, weaker_source, split_tier), joined on source_db = half, city and year: the complete tier table. The registry row of an edition (edition id, race date, official count and source type, timing basis) is edition_meta.parquet's; where both name an edition their tiers must be equal
